_doc: MAX2 U1(1) material zoning per fighter (art/tools/zone_grade.py; pipeline.build re-applies it after every build). Each zone: parts of the bake's part map, or boxes (rest position, Blender axes, m) x an ORM roughness band [lo, hi] x an optional min/max L*; hex = the hue (CIELAB angle of the colour), L = the zone's mean L*, C = its chroma, k = the texel's own L* deviation kept (default 1). Signature hues are content/fighters/<id>.json vfx.signature. Gate: lineup_qa sigPct >= 6 % and the bottom value band at L* 20-35.

zones.why: signature coral on the cowl and the shoulder wrap (mid body)
the robe a deeper terracotta, apart from the cream hood and pauldrons
lower body: the trousers and boots lifted into the bible's bottom band (lineup_qa bottom L* 17.6 before, band 20-35)
boots, the darkest part of the bottom band

signature oxblood red on the coat (mid body). Box zones, not part names: Burdam's paint-pose wrapper writes no part map, so a rebuild (cards lane) would leave a stale one. The head, mask and cowl are untouched (cards lane)
the skirt, the part the game camera sees under the cowl, a deeper oxblood (lower body); minL keeps the trousers inside it dark
signature violet on the stole and sash (mid body)
the long skirt a dusk violet-slate, darker than before (lower body), kept in the bottom band (lineup_qa)
signature plum on the robe skirt (mid and lower body)
signature crimson on the slate torso cloth (no part map: torso box x cloth roughness x the darker cloth only, not the pale cowl, sleeves or apron)
the trousers a dark crimson (lower body; the chest plate and pale cowl cover most of the torso at the game camera)
